fluff.overview: The Word of Blake Militia inherited ComStar's combined-arms organizational philosophy and its Star League-era equipment stocks, fielding infantry formations that ranked among the best equipped in the Inner Sphere during the Jihad. Mechanized tracked Level I formations rode APCs that could keep pace with armor across broken terrain, providing the all-terrain mobility and armor protection that garrison duty on undeveloped worlds demanded. The tracked transport kept these troops mobile even on worlds where roads were poor or nonexistent. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
